tagline: Bond-style ratings for every Microsoft Fabric item
brief: An independent site that grades each Microsoft Fabric item the way a credit agency grades a bond, from AAA down to C, scored by Microsoft MVPs and practitioners. The mark should feel trustworthy, precise and independent, live in the site's Fabric green, and work as a 16 px favicon.
criteria: Success: reads as a rating at a glance, ties to Fabric without copying Microsoft's branding, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Threaded A
concepts.idea: The top grade's A, with a crossbar woven over one leg and under the other: the rating and the fabric in one letter.
rationale: The A stands for the AAA end of the scale without spelling out a grade
The over-and-under crossbar is a woven thread, a quiet nod to Fabric
Built from straight cuts on a 256 grid, with a pixel-snapped cut for favicons
The wordmark's baseline sits on the crossbar's bottom edge, so symbol and name lock together

recommendation: Threaded A in Fabric green (#117865), with the two-tone wordmark that matches the site's top bar.
next_steps: Replace the site's favicon and top-bar mark with the new files
Run a trademark search before wider use
Pick the Pantone match from a physical guide before any spot-colour print
